info.name: CareX — Udemy Training REST API
info.description:
Reusable training collection for CareX API v1. Import one environment (Dev or Test) and select it before running. Use synthetic training data only. Start with Public discovery, then Patient authentication, Patient appointment lifecycle, and Staff workflows. Patient bookings are immediately confirmed; there is no doctor-approval state.

Fresh-run workflow: patient and staff preflights follow their own login. All generated IDs are saved to the active environment and collection. Use the isolated synthetic Dev environment. Default login uses seeded demo accounts. Enable runSignup only with a fresh patientEmail. MFA verification runs only when login returns a challenge; supply mfaCode from the captured/test mailbox. Enable runAccountRecovery only for a disposable identity, supplying resetToken and newPassword. Logout follows all protected operations. Never export current bearer tokens or use this write-enabled workflow on production.
